cases.name: Klaw, Master of Sound
cases.text:
Deathtouch
Whenever you play a card from exile, Klaw gains flying until end of turn.
Whenever Klaw deals combat damage to a player, look at the top card of that player's library, then exile it face down. You may play it for as long as it remains exiled. Mana of any type can be spent to cast a spell this way.

cases.name: Prosper, Tome-Bound
cases.text:
Deathtouch
At the beginning of your end step, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.
Whenever you play a card from exile, create two Treasure tokens.
